C1665.title: Stripe Webhook Signature Bypass via Empty Secret Enables Unlimited Quota Fraud
C1665.summary: A QuantumNous/new-api security advisory disclosed an empty-secret bypass in Stripe webhook signature verification. When the webhook secret is empty or misconfigured, attackers can forge events so that the system misjudges payment status and grants quota or completes orders. The vulnerability shows that payment callbacks must require a signing secret and verify event origin, order ownership, and amount consistency. Webhooks are high-trust payment-system entry points. If signing secrets can be empty or test settings reach production, attackers can create trusted callbacks without real payment and bypass business-side balance or quota controls.
